extraction_notes: Identity verified from the FMMT493 title, NPN polarity, Rev:1.0, and Zhuhai Hongjiacheng Technology Co., Ltd. footer; manufacturer string preserved as hongjiacheng.

Figures 1 through 5 are usable DC curves and were manually digitized at a compact set of visible trace locations. Values are converted from plotted mA and mV axes to SI units; points are observed readings, not interpolations.
Fig. 1 is a common-emitter static output family at TA = 25 degC with labeled base-current traces. Representative IB = 3 uA, 15 uA, and 30 uA traces are retained.
Fig. 2 DC current gain has a logarithmic IC axis and linear hFE axis; both plotted temperatures and VCE = 10 V are preserved.

Fig. 3 and Fig. 4 curves are at beta = 10; their logarithmic IC axes and plotted temperatures are preserved. The tabulated VCE(sat), VBE(sat), and hFE values are guaranteed bounds and remain minimum or maximum source_kind values rather than typical values.
The table provides four hFE rows with minimum and maximum bounds. Each bound is represented as a separate gain_points entry so the minimum/maximum semantics are retained.

The table provides VCE(sat) maximums at IC = 500 mA, IB = 50 mA and IC = 1000 mA, IB = 100 mA. VBE(sat) has only the latter maximum row; the first saturation entry therefore uses null for the permitted missing vbe_sat field.

The schema has no dedicated VBE(on), VCBO, VEBO, ICBO, IEBO, collector-current maximum, power-dissipation, or thermal-rating fields; available VBE(on) information is represented by Fig. 5 and unrelated ratings are not forced into another field.
No Cib scalar is tabulated. The plotted Fig. 6 capacitance curves are not included because this extraction is limited to usable DC F2 evidence; cibo remains null.
